_comment: SKETCH, not a catalog pack: the military-campaign bible docs/PIVOTAL_HISTORY_ENGINE.md §3 describes, kept here only to prove the bible designer's contract is domain-agnostic (§7: the pack validator must accept biography.json unchanged and a sketched campaign pack). Nothing reads it in the app, and it is not in story/schemas/_index.json; that waits on the owner's go. Every value in a real campaign comes from a source, with the quote in the change's evidence, exactly as biography.json requires.
summary: Armies, commanders, battles and technologies as dated, sourced facts: strength, supply and ground held change across chapters, and a chronicle's printed number is checked against the folded one instead of averaged.

army.name: Strength
army.llmHint: As a source gives it. Two sources that disagree are two printed rows, never an average.

army.name: Supply
army.llmHint: Days of food and fodder on hand, where a source states it.

army.name: Ground Held
army.llmHint: Places held, dated, as the sources name them.

army.name: Led By
army.llmHint: Who commanded it, dated. Command changes are turning points.

commander.name: Allegiance
commander.llmHint: Whom they served, dated, as sourced.

commander.name: Born
commander.llmHint: As the source gives it; 'c.' only when the source does.

battle.name: Outcome
battle.llmHint: What the sources say happened, with disagreements named.

technology.name: Mechanism
technology.llmHint: How it works, from a technical or scholarly source.

technology.name: Cost
technology.llmHint: What it cost to field: training years, materials, remounts.

technology.name: Limit
technology.llmHint: Where it stopped working: range, weather, terrain.

source.name: Licence
source.llmHint: cc-by-sa: take the fact, never the passage.
